title: Guernica (Picasso)
story: A horse screams at the center, head thrown back, while a bull stands over a mother holding her dead child.

title: Portrait of a Musician
story: The sheet music is the only clue.

title: Las Meninas
story: At the centre of the big dim room stands a little girl in white, and nearly everyone around her is looking at us.

title: Portrait of Isabella d'Este
story: Isabella d'Este turns her head into profile while her shoulders remain angled toward us.

title: The Night Watch
story: A small girl in gold walks through the armed company, a dead chicken hanging from her belt, while the captain in black strides forward, hand out.

title: The Starry Night
story: Look at the village first.

title: The Last Supper
story: Every hand in the room is moving.

title: Water Lilies (Monet series)
story: Water Lilies (French: Nymphéas [nɛ̃.fe.a]) is a series of approximately 250 oil paintings by French Impressionist Claude Monet (1840–1926).

title: The Birth of Venus
story: The Birth of Venus (Italian: Nascita di Venere [ˈnaʃʃita di ˈvɛːnere]) is a painting by the Italian artist Sandro Botticelli, probably executed in the mid-1480s.

title: Dinos of the Gorgon Painter
story: The Dinos of the Gorgon Painter (French: Dinos du Peintre de la Gorgone) is an important example of ancient Greek pottery, produced at Athens around 580 BC.

title: Portrait of Madeleine
story: Portrait of Madeleine, also known as Portrait of a Black Woman (French: Portrait d'une femme noire or Portrait d'une negresse), is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Marie-Guillemine Benoist, created in 1800.

title: Beach in Pourville
story: The beach opens in a pale sweep between green-blue water and the cliffs.

title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
story: The Garden of Earthly Delights (Dutch: De tuin der lusten, lit.

title: American Gothic
story:
A stern man in overalls holds a pitchfork, and a woman in a dark apron stands at his shoulder looking aside.
Behind them is a white wooden house with a pointed Gothic window.

title: The Creation of Adam
story: Two hands reach across an empty gap of plaster sky, and they do not touch; the whole history of painting hangs in that inch.

title: Impression, Sunrise
story: The sun is the only warm thing here.

title: Artists in Isabey's Studio
story:
A crowd of men in coats and hats press into a dark studio, with a few faces lit and the rest in shadow.
Some sit and some stand around a central group, and a pale figure sits low at the middle.

title: Self-Portrait (Chassériau)
story:
A young man in a black coat stands with one hand resting on a red-covered table, and his dark hair falls over his forehead.
The wall behind him is a smoky gray-brown.

title: Portrait of Madame Marie-Louise Trudaine
story: Madame Trudaine sits against a broad red background, wearing a dark dress, a white neckerchief and a bright blue sash.

title: Portrait of a Young Girl (Guérin)
story: Her hair is cut short in the new fashion, the style they called à la victime, worn in memory of the guillotine's cropped heads.

title: Portrait of Monsieur Bertin
story: Bertin sits squarely facing us, both hands spread over his knees.

title: Pierrot (Watteau)
story:
A figure in a loose white suit stands stiff, arms at his sides, in front of a tree-filled landscape.
He wears a flat pale hat and white slippers.

title: Christ Blessing (Raphael)
story: Christ raises one hand in blessing while the other rests near the wound in his side.

title: Conestabile Madonna
story: Mary bends over a small open book while the Christ Child follows its pages from her arms.

title: Portrait of an African Man
story:
A man in a red cap and a black coat with red sleeves looks off to the left, and a gloved hand rests at his waist.
A white collar shows at his neck, and a dark pendant hangs on a cord.

title: Portrait of Andrea Navagero and Agostino Beazzano
story: Two men in dark clothing turn towards the viewer against a green background.

title: Armada Portrait
artist: Unknown English artist (formerly attributed to George Gower)

title: Portrait of Bindo Altoviti
story: Bindo Altoviti looks back over his shoulder, his long fair hair falling against a blue garment that leaves part of his upper back bare.

title: Annunciation
story: The angel has just landed, wing tips still lifted.

title: The Holy Infants Embracing
story: The Holy Infants Embracing is a painting by Leonardo da Vinci.
